description: Per-task verdicts behind the paper's main-body tables and figures (scripts/analyze.py --source paper). Rows are in the order the paper's intervals were computed in.

columns.setting: oracle: the condition's components of the target API's bundle in the prompt (RQ1); retrieval: the top-5 retrieved chunks instead (RQ2)
columns.passed: greedy pass@1 verdict (1 = passes, including the call-record check)
columns.label: Pass or the failure label (WrongAPISelection, WrongImport, WrongSyntax, WrongParam, WrongShapeDtype, WrongLogic)
columns.call_check_failed: 1 when the completion ran and called the target API but failed only the call-record check
columns.pass_at_5: unbiased pass@5 from 20 samples at temperature 0.8 (primary backbone, oracle setting); empty where not evaluated
columns.target_rank: 1-based rank of the first chunk of the task's target API in the full ranking of the domain's retrieval index for the condition (primary backbone)
